exact_title: Comparison of Cardiovascular Outcomes Between Dapagliflozin and Empagliflozin in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes: A Meta-Analysis
source_type: systematic review and meta-analysis of retrospective comparative cohorts
sections_or_headings: Comparison of Cardiovascular Outcomes Between Dapagliflozin and Empagliflozin

figures.title: Flowchart of the study selection
figures.key_data: 288 identified (PubMed 128, CINAHL 100, Embase 60); 207 after duplicates; 207 screened; 185 excluded; 22 full text; 18 full-text excluded (review 3, placebo comparison 12, abstract only 1, other 2); 4 included.

tables.title: Characteristics of included studies
tables.key_data: Four retrospective cohorts; dapagliflozin/empagliflozin sample sizes: 921/921, 609/600, 5812/6869, 5302/4681; follow-up 55.1, 38.9, 32.66, 29.13 months.

tables.title: Risk of bias assessment of the included studies
tables.key_data: Adapted Newcastle-Ottawa scores: Lim 8/8, Park 7/8, Shao 7/8, Suzuki 8/8.

algorithms_or_workflows: PRISMA study-selection workflow represented by Figure 1.

visual_strategy.note: Online PDF screenshot API was attempted and failed with a cache miss. The original Drive PDF was rendered locally for visual reconciliation; all load-bearing visual values were reconstructed as structured blocks in the SEA.

coverage_decision: All main-text figures and tables included as structured blocks; bibliography condensed only into the separate reference-list artifact, not the SEA narrative.
omissions: Reference entries are not atomized as evidence; they are exported separately as provenance infrastructure.
